title: Mechanisms of Longdan Xiegan decoction-aggravated D-Galactosamine-induced liver injury: Gut microbiota-mediated geniposide biotransformation and TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway activation.
authors: Zhang, Ranran; Ling, Yingjie; Sun, Jiaxin; Yang, Xiudong; He, Zhi; Zhang, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨龙胆泻肝汤加重肝损伤的机制，涉及肠道菌群和TLR4/NF-kB通路，虽含分子对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study aimed to evaluate the aggravating effect of overdosed Longdan Xiegan Decoction (LXD) on D-galactosamine-induced liver injury and to investigate the underlying mechanisms. Histopathological examination, serum biochemical analysis (ALT, AST), serum LPS levels, inflammatory cytokine expression, 16S rRNA gene sequencing of gut microbiota, and untargeted fecal metabolomics were performed to assess the effects of LXD at doses of 150, 300, and 600 mg/kg. LC-MS was employed to analyze gut bacterial biotransformation products of LXD. Network pharmacology and molecular docking were used to predict potential genipin-interacting proteins. An LPS-induced LX-2 cell model was established to evaluate the effects of excessive genipin on cell viability and ROS production. Flow cytometry, Western blot, and immunofluorescence were applied to investigate the activation of the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway. 600 mg/kg LXD significantly aggravated liver injury and enhanced the gut biotransformation of geniposide to genipin by altering gut microbiota composition. TLR4 was identified as a potential mediator of genipin effects. Moreover, excessive genipin reduced cell viability, increased ROS levels, and elevated expression of TLR4, MyD88, and NF-kappaB p65, along with promoting nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65 in LX-2 cells. Overdosed LXD aggravates D-galactosamine-induced liver injury through gut microbiota-mediated biotransformation of geniposide to genipin, which subsequently activates the TLR4/NF-kappaB inflammatory pathway.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在评估过量龙胆泻肝汤（LXD）对D-半乳糖胺诱导肝损伤的加重作用，并探讨其潜在机制。通过组织病理学检查、血清生化分析（ALT、AST）、血清LPS水平、炎症细胞因子表达、肠道菌群16S rRNA基因测序及非靶向粪便代谢组学，评估LXD在150、300和600 mg/kg剂量下的效应。采用LC-MS分析LXD的肠道细菌生物转化产物。利用网络药理学和分子对接预测潜在的京尼平相互作用蛋白。建立LPS诱导的LX-2细胞模型，以评估过量京尼平对细胞活力和ROS产生的影响。应用流式细胞术、Western blot和免疫荧光研究TLR4/NF-kappaB通路的激活。600 mg/kg LXD显著加重肝损伤，并通过改变肠道菌群组成增强京尼平苷向京尼平的肠道生物转化。TLR4被确定为京尼平效应的潜在介导因子。此外，过量京尼平降低细胞活力、增加ROS水平，并上调TLR4、MyD88和NF-kappaB p65的表达，同时促进LX-2细胞中NF-kappaB p65的核转位。过量LXD通过肠道菌群介导的京尼平苷向京尼平的生物转化加重D-半乳糖胺诱导的肝损伤，进而激活TLR4/NF-kappaB炎症通路。
